mapper.select: select p.created_at AS createdAt, c.trade_name AS tradeName, p.name AS productName, TO_NUMBER(p.supply_price) + (TO_NUMBER(p.supply_price) * 0.1) AS priceSum, ps.type AS type, sw.name AS warehouseName from product p join shipment_warehouse sw ON p.warehouse = sw.id left join estimate_product ep ON ep.product = p.id left join estimate e ON ep.estimate = e.id left join client c ON e.client = c.id left join order_sale os ON os.product = p.id left join product_sale ps ON os.product_sale = ps.id group by p.created_at, c.trade_name, p.name, p.supply_price, ps.type, sw.name
